verdict.rationale: Docs show several plugins (Slack, Security, Drive, iMessage) that read connected data and produce AI-generated outputs like summaries, drafted replies, and vulnerability findings, which matches the 'insights from my data' story, but this capability is scattered across optional installable plugins rather than a built-in analytics/insights feature and lacks independent hands-on validation of insight quality. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of insight accuracy/usefulness, and a dedicated cross-plugin insights/dashboard experience rather than per-plugin ad hoc summarization.
